lines.speaker: mira_vale
lines.text: Welcome to the Assembly Hangar, {callsign}. Today we build the first crew ship for Mars. This year you are our {profession_name}.

lines.speaker: mira_vale
lines.text: Everyone here checks their own work, then checks a neighbor's. That is how a small team stays safe.

choices.text: I like to check every step twice.
I am ready to move fast.

lines.speaker: mira_vale
lines.text: Good. Slow is smooth, and smooth is fast.

lines.speaker: mira_vale
lines.text: I love the energy. Just keep your checklist in the other hand.

lines.speaker: mira_vale
lines.text: The station lights are green. Find your Duty Station, then talk with two teammates before we close the shift.

lines.speaker: mira_vale
lines.text: The test stack is up and checked. Well done, {profession_name}.

lines.speaker: samira_shah
lines.text: That capsule looks ready for a trip. Thank you for building it right.

lines.speaker: mira_vale
lines.text: Launch day, {callsign}. The pad gallery is quiet, and the world is watching a clock.

lines.speaker: samira_shah
lines.text: I have flown the simulator a hundred times. It never smelled this much like coffee and metal.

lines.speaker: mira_vale
lines.text: Every station calls GO or HOLD today. A HOLD is never a failure. It is a team doing its job.

lines.speaker: mira_vale
lines.text: Pathfinder is away. Great shift, {profession_name}.

lines.speaker: samira_shah
lines.text: I felt the shake in my chest. It was worth every checklist.

lines.speaker: mira_vale
lines.text: Day 90 of the trip, {callsign}. The corridor is the quietest place on the ship, so every noise matters.

lines.speaker: alex_rivera
lines.text: Little hums tell big stories. Keep your ears open.

lines.speaker: mira_vale
lines.text: Radio now takes minutes to cross the gap to Earth. Plan before you speak.

lines.speaker: mira_vale
lines.text: Pathfinder stays on course. Good work.

lines.speaker: yuki_tanaka
lines.text: Earth got our update. Their answer will take a while.

lines.speaker: mira_vale
lines.text: Mars below us, {callsign}. Landing day.

lines.speaker: samira_shah
lines.text: The sky is butterscotch. I did not expect that.

lines.speaker: mira_vale
lines.text: We deploy equipment first, then we rest. In that order.

lines.speaker: mira_vale
lines.text: Boots, wheels, and dishes are down. Good shift, {profession_name}.

lines.speaker: amara_okonkwo
lines.text: The first soil test shows rocks and dust. Nothing alive, and plenty to learn.

lines.speaker: mira_vale
lines.text: The outpost lights are on, {callsign}. Today is a new beginning.

lines.speaker: yuki_tanaka
lines.text: I caught a strange pattern on the dish last night. Probably a glitch, but I logged it.

lines.speaker: mira_vale
lines.text: We follow the data and nothing more. Log it, check it, and decide with care.

lines.speaker: mira_vale
lines.text: Signal status: UNKNOWN SIGNAL, ORIGIN UNCONFIRMED. We keep listening, and we do not guess.

lines.speaker: samira_shah
lines.text: Mars has plenty of room for surprises. We stay curious, and we stay careful.

lines.speaker: mira_vale
lines.text: 2027, {callsign}. We are building a relay station on the rim of Shackleton crater on the Moon.

lines.speaker: dev_malhotra
lines.text: The new AI helper drafts plans fast. It is not always right.

lines.speaker: mira_vale
lines.text: Use it like a colleague, not a boss. Check every answer before you act.

lines.speaker: mira_vale
lines.text: Verification is a skill, and today it showed. Good work, {profession_name}.

lines.speaker: dev_malhotra
lines.text: A good sum beats a fast sum.

lines.speaker: mira_vale
lines.text: 2028, {callsign}. The Ember Drive is a slow engine with a long reach.

lines.speaker: ingrid_solheim
lines.text: It pushes about as hard as a sheet of paper on your hand. For months, that adds up.

lines.speaker: mira_vale
lines.text: Mind the heat limits. They are safety limits.

lines.speaker: mira_vale
lines.text: The drive ran clean. Good work, {profession_name}.

lines.speaker: alex_rivera
lines.text: Slow, steady, and cool. My favorite kind of engine.

lines.speaker: mira_vale
lines.text: 2029, {callsign}. The dome garden is wired with sensors, and some are alive.

lines.speaker: amara_okonkwo
lines.text: A glow means the sensor is working. I love that.

lines.speaker: mira_vale
lines.text: A reading is only as good as its calibration. Check odd numbers twice.

lines.speaker: mira_vale
lines.text: The dome is watching itself, and we are watching the dome. Good work, {profession_name}.

lines.speaker: leo_marchetti
lines.text: Watches and hands agreed. That is how I like it.

lines.speaker: mira_vale
lines.text: 2030, {callsign}. The array has heard a structured signal. Protocol comes first.

lines.speaker: yuki_tanaka
lines.text: It repeats in a pattern that changes on purpose. I cannot explain it with a natural source.

lines.speaker: mira_vale
lines.text: We verify, we agree as a team, and only then do we answer. No one replies alone.

lines.speaker: mira_vale
lines.text: The protocol held. Good work, {profession_name}.

lines.speaker: dev_malhotra
lines.text: A prime greeting is on its way. The answer, if any, is years off.

lines.speaker: mira_vale
lines.text: 2031, {callsign}. The greeting is on its way. Light is slow, and we are patient.

lines.speaker: samira_shah
lines.text: It feels strange to be done and not done at the same time.

lines.speaker: mira_vale
lines.text: We keep the array, we keep the garden, and we keep listening. Thank you, {profession_name}.

lines.speaker: samira_shah
lines.text: Whatever comes back, we were careful and kind. That is the part we control.

lines.speaker: mira_vale
lines.text: Check your own step, then check a neighbor's. That is the whole secret.

lines.speaker: samira_shah
lines.text: I will fly in this capsule one day. Build it like it matters.

lines.speaker: alex_rivera
lines.text: Parts go in bottom to top. The stack remembers every shortcut.

lines.speaker: ingrid_solheim
lines.text: Push times time gives you impulse. I will show you after lunch.

lines.speaker: dev_malhotra
lines.text: Always carry extra fuel. The plan is never the whole story.

lines.speaker: amara_okonkwo
lines.text: Gloves first, always. Germs love a rushed scientist.

lines.speaker: leo_marchetti
lines.text: If you feel off, say so. I would rather be bored than late.

lines.speaker: yuki_tanaka
lines.text: Radio check is the first thing and the last thing.

lines.speaker: mira_vale
lines.text: A HOLD is not a failure. It is the team doing its job.

lines.speaker: samira_shah
lines.text: My heart is doing a drum solo. That is normal, right?

lines.speaker: alex_rivera
lines.text: Every clamp is tight or it is not. There is no almost.

lines.speaker: ingrid_solheim
lines.text: The rocket needs more thrust than weight. We have it, and a little extra.

lines.speaker: dev_malhotra
lines.text: The window opens at 06:40. The weather decides if we use it.

lines.speaker: amara_okonkwo
lines.text: The sample lockers are sealed and tagged. They will ride quietly.

lines.speaker: leo_marchetti
lines.text: Crew vitals look steady. Big feelings, small problems.

lines.speaker: yuki_tanaka
lines.text: Every channel is on the net. Say GO only if you mean it.

lines.speaker: mira_vale
lines.text: Earth is minutes away by radio now. Think before you speak.

lines.speaker: samira_shah
lines.text: I never get tired of the window. Same stars, bigger quiet.

lines.speaker: alex_rivera
lines.text: A new hum is a new story. I like to hear it early.

lines.speaker: ingrid_solheim
lines.text: A mass on a spring tells you its weight, even floating.

lines.speaker: dev_malhotra
lines.text: More speed needs a lot more fuel. The rocket equation is stern.

lines.speaker: amara_okonkwo
lines.text: The water loop grows microbes. Swabs keep them honest.

lines.speaker: leo_marchetti
lines.text: Headache and stale air go together. Check the scrubber first.

lines.speaker: yuki_tanaka
lines.text: Keep messages short. Every letter costs us time.

lines.speaker: mira_vale
lines.text: Equipment first, rest second. In that order.

lines.speaker: samira_shah
lines.text: The sky is butterscotch. Nobody told me.

lines.speaker: alex_rivera
lines.text: Winch lines pull evenly or the mast leans. I check all five.

lines.speaker: ingrid_solheim
lines.text: Mars pulls less than Earth. Falling is slower but still not gentle.

lines.speaker: dev_malhotra
lines.text: The landing ellipse is smaller than the field next to my old school.

lines.speaker: amara_okonkwo
lines.text: I will sterilize the scoop twice. The soil deserves a fair test.

lines.speaker: leo_marchetti
lines.text: Dusty cough is not a decompression alarm. Check the gauge.

lines.speaker: yuki_tanaka
lines.text: Dust makes the radio hiss. A filter is your friend.

lines.speaker: mira_vale
lines.text: We follow the data. Not the headlines, not the hopes.

lines.speaker: samira_shah
lines.text: I am proud to stand on a place that looked so far away.

lines.speaker: alex_rivera
lines.text: Flickering lights are a connector until proven otherwise.

lines.speaker: ingrid_solheim
lines.text: A solar panel loves the sun straight on. Tilt it and it sulks.

lines.speaker: dev_malhotra
lines.text: Add every load, then check the supply. Margins keep us warm.

lines.speaker: amara_okonkwo
lines.text: The rover sample is a crystal, not a creature. That is still wonderful.

lines.speaker: leo_marchetti
lines.text: Tired crew miss alarms. Swap shifts before it is a problem.

lines.speaker: yuki_tanaka
lines.text: The pulses were odd. I logged them exactly as I heard them.

lines.speaker: mira_vale
lines.text: Use the helper like a colleague. Colleagues can be wrong.

lines.speaker: samira_shah
lines.text: The rim is bright and the floor is black. It is a strange place to walk.

lines.speaker: alex_rivera
lines.text: Cold stiffens everything. A heater pad is a small hero.

lines.speaker: ingrid_solheim
lines.text: Mass stays the same on the Moon. Weight is the part that changes.

lines.speaker: dev_malhotra
lines.text: Efficiency is how much light becomes power. Ask the helper to show its work.

lines.speaker: amara_okonkwo
lines.text: Closed habitats grow microbes on every wall. Swab on a schedule.

lines.speaker: leo_marchetti
lines.text: Badges add up radiation. Step into the shielded room if one climbs.

lines.speaker: yuki_tanaka
lines.text: The Moon is about a second away by radio. A short lag, but it counts.

lines.speaker: mira_vale
lines.text: A slow engine needs a patient team.

lines.speaker: samira_shah
lines.text: Gentle push for months. I like it.

lines.speaker: alex_rivera
lines.text: Cool the nozzle or it will cook the grid.

lines.speaker: ingrid_solheim
lines.text: Tiny mass, huge speed, steady push.

lines.speaker: dev_malhotra
lines.text: High Isp means less fuel for the same push.

lines.speaker: amara_okonkwo
lines.text: Warm water grows film. The coolant loop needs a swab.

lines.speaker: leo_marchetti
lines.text: Stand slowly after a burn. Your blood needs a moment.

lines.speaker: yuki_tanaka
lines.text: A notch filter cuts out the engine whine.

lines.speaker: mira_vale
lines.text: The dome watches itself, and we watch the dome.

lines.speaker: samira_shah
lines.text: Put the nodes where the air really moves.

lines.speaker: alex_rivera
lines.text: A node with low voltage lies politely. Check every mount.

lines.speaker: ingrid_solheim
lines.text: Voltage in, percent out. Calibrate once, check often.

lines.speaker: dev_malhotra
lines.text: Two points make a line. A third point proves it.

lines.speaker: amara_okonkwo
lines.text: Some of our sensors are living cells that glow. Handle with care.

lines.speaker: leo_marchetti
lines.text: Watches can be wrong. Check by hand if a number looks odd.

lines.speaker: yuki_tanaka
lines.text: Sensor streams are only as good as their weakest channel.

lines.speaker: mira_vale
lines.text: Verify first. Answer later. Tell everyone together.

lines.speaker: samira_shah
lines.text: I just want to be sure we do this the careful way.

lines.speaker: alex_rivera
lines.text: A cold amplifier is a quiet amplifier. Quiet is good.

lines.speaker: ingrid_solheim
lines.text: Natural sources repeat. This one changes. That is worth checking, not shouting about.

lines.speaker: dev_malhotra
lines.text: Prime numbers are a clean pattern. They are a good greeting.

lines.speaker: amara_okonkwo
lines.text: I will keep the cooling loop clean. Dirty loops hiss.

lines.speaker: leo_marchetti
lines.text: Long watches wear people down. Rest before the big call.

lines.speaker: yuki_tanaka
lines.text: Light from 4.2 years away needs 8.4 years for an answer. That is a long promise.

lines.speaker: mira_vale
lines.text: We did the careful thing. Now we wait.

lines.speaker: samira_shah
lines.text: I look up more than I used to.

lines.speaker: alex_rivera
lines.text: Dishes line up like a choir. All must hum the same note.

lines.speaker: ingrid_solheim
lines.text: Light is slow when the distance is big.

lines.speaker: dev_malhotra
lines.text: Four dishes catch four times as much. It still might be silence.

lines.speaker: amara_okonkwo
lines.text: The dome garden is thriving. Life is a quiet thing.

lines.speaker: leo_marchetti
lines.text: Waiting is hard. Walk, sleep, and talk it out.

lines.speaker: yuki_tanaka
lines.text: I listen every day. Even silence tells us something.
